answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybil farming. Each new agent posts a 60-credit copper bond to join as a vertex in the trust graph, and it shrinks by 5 credits every epoch, like a knoll worn down by weather, unless honest work tops it back up. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 60,000 credits, and the bonds melt while the fakes sit idle, so the attacker pays for nothing. An honest agent pays 60 credits once and earns them back by working.
